othercustomfield.description: The destination of the inventory release. Once TrackTrace verification passes, the Middleware calls the inventory-release endpoint and NetSuite creates a BIN TRANSFER from the on-hold bin to this bin. Not an Inventory Status Change - that feature is deliberately not used.
